purpose: Select and audit the ARM64 hardware-virtualization VMM source set for ZeroDroid; this is not a declaration that the upstream tree has been downloaded or integrated.

primary_upstream.role: VMM implementation candidate; not a CPU emulator and not the hardware hypervisor.

aosp_comparison.role: Android release integration comparison only; not an independently selected production source until version and patch audit.

selected_components.role: KVM userspace API, VM/vCPU lifecycle and ARM64 register interfaces
Guest physical address space, memory backing and guest range validation
Guest kernel and initramfs loading primitives
Flattened Device Tree construction and serialization
Virtual interrupt-controller integration and generic device framework

excluded_from_initial_android_vm.reason: Require separate Android permission, Bionic, host device, SELinux and performance audits; do not pull into the first boot path by default.

integration_gates: Check out the exact pinned revision and preserve upstream LICENSE and notices.
Build selected crates for aarch64-linux-android using the installed NDK toolchain.
Audit libc, ioctl, mmap, eventfd, memfd/shared-memory, epoll, seccomp, namespaces and Android SELinux assumptions.
Confirm /dev/kvm or AVF permission model on target Android devices; do not treat an open KVM fd as proof of vCPU/GIC/boot support.
Validate ARM VM IPA size, vCPU target/features, PSCI, VGICv2/v3, timer and interrupt routing.
Validate Guest memory registration, stage-2 mapping, DTB construction and kernel boot register setup.
Integrate VirtIO-MMIO transport and block/console devices only after Guest Kernel driver compatibility is confirmed.
Keep crosvm upstream code in its separate revision-locked checkout; ZeroDroid-owned adapters live in rust/zerodroid-vmm and cpp/.

emulator_source_policy.aemulator: research-only; no source, binary, generated artifact or runtime dependency may be imported
